description: Makes a table tab — typed columns, one record per row, with grid, board and form views — in an existing sheet, or in a new sheet when sheetId is omitted. Use a table (not napkin_sheets_set_cells) for lists people keep: requests, vendors, bugs, contacts. The first column names each record. Column types: text, long_text, number, date, checkbox, select, multi_select, person, url, email.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

description.description: What the column holds — shown to people and to interfaces.

options.description: Choices, for select and multi_select columns.

sheetId.description: Add to this sheet; omit to make a new sheet.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this.

name: napkin_tables_create
title: Make a table of records
